name: inventory
title: Inventory
summary: How many units exist and in which stock group: stock items per offer/SKU with Available, Reserved, Incoming, Damaged or held and Returned quantities per location, checkout holds and order allocations, an append-only movement ledger, reasoned adjustments with second review, low-stock alerts, receipt confirmation and return stock outcomes.
owns: Stock items: one per seller offer, one per Official Store SKU; seller stock never mixed with company stock
Quantities per stock group (Available, Reserved, Incoming, Damaged or held, Returned) per location
Stock locations (warehouse sites; one at launch, more in phase 4) and transfers between them (phase 4)
Reservations: checkout holds with expiry, allocation on order acceptance, fulfilment on dispatch, release on cancel
Movement ledger: every quantity change with reason, staff member, reference and time
Adjustments with reason codes; second review above the role's limit (via access)
Confirmation of received stock (Incoming → Available / Damaged or held) by the Inventory Manager
Stock outcome of inspected returns (restock, different condition, damaged stock, repair, return to supplier, write-off)
Discrepancies reported by the warehouse (pick shortage, damage found) and their resolution
Weighted average unit cost of company stock (valuation at cost)
notOwns: Bins and physical put-away: warehouse (inventory only shows the primary bin code it is told about)
Purchase orders, receipts and supplier claims: purchasing
Prices, offer status and the seller bulk file: offers (inventory applies the quantity rows)
Return inspection and condition decision: returns
Seller storage and handling for the future fulfillment service: fulfillment-service (inventory already keys items by owner)

stateMachines.name: Reservation
stateMachines.notes: held: checkout hold (Available → Reserved) with expiresAt, extended while a payment result is checked. allocate on orders.order.accepted. fulfill on shipping.shipment.dispatched (Reserved → outside). release on cancellation (orders.item.cancelled) or abandoned checkout: Reserved → Available. Released units return to Available only when the purchase has ended or been cancelled (plan ch. 9). Lines move individually (partial cancel or partial shipment); the reservation state is the furthest state of its open lines.

stateMachines.name: Adjustment
stateMachines.notes: requestReview when access says the quantity or value at cost is above the requester's adjustment limit (example: Inventory Manager 50 units). approve/reject come from access.approval.decided; the reviewer must be a different person. Nothing moves until applied. Seller adjustments on their own stock apply directly.

stateMachines.name: Inbound confirmation
stateMachines.notes: Units stay in Incoming until confirm: sellable → Available, damaged → Damaged or held (review date = supplier claim follow-up). Out-of-stock SKUs allocate waiting orders first.

stateMachines.name: Return stock outcome
stateMachines.notes: Created on returns.return.inspected. restock: Returned → Available. different_condition: Returned → outside on this item and outside → Available on the target item, at the original unit cost. damaged_stock: Returned → Damaged or held (kept, not for sale) with a review date. repair / return_to_supplier: Returned → Damaged or held with a review date. write_off: Returned → outside; value at cost reported to finance.

stateMachines.name: Discrepancy
stateMachines.notes: Opened by warehouse pick shortages and damage at packing. The affected order stays on hold in warehouse until resolved (inventory.discrepancy.resolved).

stateMachines.name: Transfer
stateMachines.notes: Phase 4 (multiple warehouses). ship: Available at source → outside, Incoming at destination; receive: Incoming → Available.

stateMachines.name: Stock count
stateMachines.notes: Phase 4. apply creates count_correction adjustments; those above the limit go to second review.

INSUFFICIENT_STOCK.meaning: Not enough Available units. details.lines[{ stockItemId, requested, available }]

RESERVATION_EXPIRED.meaning: The checkout hold expired; create a new hold

GROUP_QUANTITY_EXCEEDED.meaning: The from-group does not hold that many units. details.group, details.quantity

RESERVED_NOT_ADJUSTABLE.meaning: Reserved units belong to orders; they move through reservations or discrepancies only

REVIEW_DATE_REQUIRED.meaning: Moving units into Damaged or held needs a review date

SELLABLE_EXCEEDS_RECEIVED.meaning: Sellable + damaged cannot exceed the received quantity on a line

SKU_TAKEN.meaning: A stock item with this SKU already exists for this owner

STOCK_ITEM_ARCHIVED.meaning: The stock item is archived (its offer was removed)

notes: Stock groups are quantities, not statuses: each stock item carries all five numbers per location. Every change writes one stock_movements row and updates stock_levels in the same transaction with an optimistic version check (CONFLICT on race).
Sellable quantity = Available at sellable locations. Checkout cannot hold more than Available (plan ch. 9: prevent selling beyond eligible available quantities).

Seller stock and company stock are separate stock items with ownerType; summaries never add them together. The future fulfillment service keeps ownerType = seller at a company warehouse location, so reports can name the stock owner.

Receiving flow (plan ch. 2, 9): purchasing records the counted receipt (warehouse staff) → inventory.submitInbound keeps the units in Incoming → Inventory Manager confirms with confirmInbound → Available / Damaged or held. Warehouse puts the units away in bins in parallel.

Return flow: warehouse receives the parcel → returns inspects and proposes an outcome → inventory records the stock outcome (recordReturnOutcome) → finance handles the refund. Inventory never decides the refund.

Second review limits come from access approval limits (e.g. Inventory Manager: adjustments over 50 units); inventory calls access.check(principal, 'inventory.adjustments.apply', { number: units }) and, on approval_required, access.requestApproval (value at cost shown to the reviewer); the adjustment stays pending until access.approval.decided.
Holds carry a reason and a review date: any units moved into Damaged or held get a held_stock row; the daily job raises the ones due for review.
The seller bulk price-and-quantity file is owned by offers (seller SKU lives there); its quantity rows are applied here through applyBulkQuantities with reason 'Bulk update'.

Exports: seller exports run through reports (registerDataset / requestExport) so permission filtering, audit and link expiry match other modules. Inventory registers dataset inventory.seller.stock (seller audience; columns: product, variant, seller SKU, condition, available, reserved, incoming, low-stock threshold, state, updated at) and serves it from POST /api/seller/inventory/stock-items/exports.
Inventory has no hard dependencies; it reads product labels through the optional catalog dependency when creating company stock items and otherwise trusts the label passed in.
